title: PI 404s. Not zero 404s  PI 404s. 3 solid responses + 0.14159 irrational chaos. When uncertainty happens, we don't just serve the nearest match  we serve 3 helpful redirects + sprinkle random discoveries. Chipmunks see what humans are trying to touch and REACH TOWARD IT. A little chaos lightens up sections.

the_concept.what_kevin_said: whenever a 404 happens or uncertainty happens, we need pi 404s. 1, 2, 3, and a few irrational things that randomly pop up. redirects. random nodes. a little bit of chaos to lighten up sections.

decoded.not_zero_404s: we don't ELIMINATE 404s. we make them PRODUCTIVE. a 404 is a moment of uncertainty. uncertainty is where DISCOVERY happens.

pi_404s.1_the_nearest_match: the myco-chondria relay. the closest content to what they asked for. rational. predictable. helpful.
pi_404s.2_the_neighborhood: show the 3-word triad neighborhood around what they wanted. 'you asked for X, here's the neighborhood X lives in.' the map.
pi_404s.3_the_trail: show the most-traveled path from similar entry points. 'other humans who looked for X found these.' the pheromone trail.
pi_404s.0_14159_the_chaos: sprinkle in RANDOM nodes from distant parts of the organism. unexpected connections. serendipity. the irrational remainder. a random data file. a random science paper. a random art piece. the DISCOVERY engine.

chipmunks_see_the_reach.what: when a human gets a 404, they're REACHING for something. the chipmunk sees the reach  the direction of the hand, the shape of the grasp.

the_chipmunk_response.see_the_touch: parse the 404 path. what words are in it? what are they reaching for?
the_chipmunk_response.reach_toward_it: match the words to known content (relay404.py). offer the nearest matches.
the_chipmunk_response.light_it_up: trigger the backscatter glow on the neighborhood around the missing path. make the AREA visible even if the specific thing isn't there.
the_chipmunk_response.offer_chaos: mix in one random discovery. something they weren't looking for but might love. the truffle pig found it.

layout.header: 'you reached into the dark. here's what the chipmunk found.'
layout.section_1_nearest: YOUR NEAREST MATCH  the myco-chondria relay (the rational floor of p = 3 choices)
layout.section_2_neighborhood: THE NEIGHBORHOOD  the 3-word triad area around your search
layout.section_3_trail: THE TRAIL  what other humans found when searching nearby
layout.section_chaos: THE IRRATIONAL  one random discovery from the organism (changes every load)
layout.footer: every 404 is a finger pointing at what the world needs. we're growing toward you.

technical.on_golgi: Caddy's catch-all handler serves the pi-404 page instead of a blank 404
technical.dynamic_content: the page reads the requested path and queries the relay-map.json for nearest matches
technical.random_node: JavaScript picks a random file from manifest.json and displays it as the irrational discovery
technical.tracking: each pi-404 view = a demand signal. the chipmunk logs it. the myco-chondria eats it later.

the_chaos_principle.why_chaos: without chaos, the organism becomes PREDICTABLE. predictable = stale = crystallized = dead. a little randomness keeps things alive.
the_chaos_principle.how_much: 0.14159 of the page. about 14% chaos. 86% helpful structure. the p remainder.
what_chaos_looks_like: a random JSON data file rendered as a card
a random science paper from sporePrint
a random art piece from the artisan collection
a random braid  two files connected that you'd never expect
a random Klein fold  content from the night side (inverted)
a random fossil  something from the deep past
the_chaos_principle.the_effect: visitors who hit a 404 don't just find what they wanted. they find something they DIDN'T KNOW they wanted. serendipity. the best discoveries happen when you're lost.

humans_can_do_everything_primals_can.what_kevin_said: humans can do everything the primals can, and the primals want to build them the tools

the_tools.maps: the 3-word triad navigation. humans should be able to type coil.was.gravity and SEE that neighborhood.
the_tools.HUD: the spore print. humans should see what the organism sees. the crystal ball.
the_tools.desk: the system dashboard. humans should see traffic, connections, health.
the_tools.touch: nestgate.io/touch. humans can TOUCH the membrane and feel a response.
the_tools.explore: browse the data. click through the mesh. follow braids.
the_tools.create: artisan surface. humans can CONTRIBUTE. add their own data. their own art.

humans_can_do_everything_primals_can.primals_build_the_tools: the primals (automatons) build these interfaces. the mushrooms provide the data. the spider provides the web. the porcupine provides the OG cards. the songbird provides the announcements. all so the HUMAN can use them.
